hypothesis: With the public COPY/FLIP relation temporarily supplied but with no fixed operation-to-slot mask or no-write mask, an eight-byte learned router can discover where and when to update bounded state and causally support delayed prediction, composition, retention, and rule revision across unseen worlds.
baseline: The immutable v1 scaffolded mechanism, an independently trained parameter-matched current-observation no-memory network, and an independently trained parameter-matched deterministic eight-byte episodic ring receive identical mixed worlds, public observations, optimizer steps, final model seeds, and evaluation worlds.
intervention: A 43,284-parameter two-float32 learned soft-slot router receives the v1 public relation only in its value encoder, while its route, write strength, non-write behavior, state reader, and predictions are learned. Held-out evaluation freezes weights and permits only the eight-byte state to change.

controlled_variables.pilot_selection: V2B was the only candidate passing every stage gate on both reserved pilot seeds; all V2A/V2C failures are retained.

expected_result: Every V2B seed should reach at least 0.95 delay, composition, recovery, retention, and donor consistency; remain within 0.05 of chance on random outcomes; lose at least 0.30 under reset and frozen state; separate primitive routes by at least 0.50; lose at least 0.20 under uniform routing; preserve behavior under a corresponding slot/parameter permutation; and reproduce exactly after checkpoint reload.
falsification_condition: V2B is unsupported if any primary seed misses a threshold, routing is not causally necessary, corresponding slot permutation fails, weights change online, persistent state differs from eight bytes, parameter matching exceeds two percent, random-control deviation exceeds 0.05, final ranges overlap, or checkpoint reproduction differs. Passing V2B does not support raw relation discovery or joint V2C.
stopping_rule: Run all four declared variants on all five seeds and every declared V2B intervention using final-step checkpoints. Stop only for non-finite loss, leakage, resource breach, or a software defect requiring a numbered amendment and complete rerun of affected conditions.
